description: Use when the user asks "is this token safe?", "is it a rug or a honeypot?", "check this CA" or "can I sell it?". Send a token contract address (Base by default; also ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, or a Solana mint), get a short verdict: LOW_RISK, CAUTION or HIGH_RISK, a 0-100 safety score, one plain-language sentence, whether a simulated sale succeeds (honeypot check), observed buy tax, liquidity, who controls the contract, the top three risks, a oneLiner to quote and a share card. Cheaper and shorter than check_token_risk. Use for a quick safe-to-buy answer; for every check and the raw contract, liquidity and simulation data use check_token_risk.

address.description: 0x-prefixed ERC-20 contract, or a base58 Solana mint

chain.description: Chain of the token or pool: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon (solana where listed). Not the payment network

name: get_token_verdict
title: Token verdict
